item.title: Enbridge anticipates protests as Line 5 construction begins
item.description: Enbridge will fund local law enforcement as Line 5 construction begins in Wisconsin, drawing opposition from Bad River Ojibwe and activists.

item.title: Private payrolls post biggest gain in 7 months
item.description: U.S. private payrolls rose 63,000 in February, the biggest gain in seven months, as wage growth held steady and Fed rate cut odds diminished.

item.title: Small businesses face uphill battle for tariff refunds
item.description: After the Supreme Court struck down Trump-era tariffs, small businesses face costly, lengthy legal fights to recover billions in tariff refunds.

item.title: Seven Steakhouse sells for $1.3M
item.description: Seven Steakhouse & Sushi has been sold for $1.3 million, this time without its billboard advertising rights, according to a recently released certificate of real estate value.

item.title: Doran Cos. buys Seven Points mall for $3 million
item.description: Doran Cos. purchased the Seven Points mall in Minneapolis for $3 million to develop a 228-unit apartment building, approved by the city in 2025.

item.title: Google announces data center plans for Hermantown
item.description: Google will develop a 1.8 million-square-foot data center in Hermantown, Minnesota, partnering with Minnesota Power to support energy efficiency and local infrastructure.

item.title: Dakota opens new Nicollet Mall performance space
item.description: Dakota, a live music venue and restaurant in Minneapolis, is opening a new private event and performance space in the historic Young-Quinlan Building in downtown Minneapolis.

item.title: Fed’s Kashkari says Iran war obscures rate cut outlook
item.description: Fed’s Neel Kashkari says U.S.-Israel conflict in Iran raises economic uncertainty, complicating interest rate policy and future Fed decisions.

item.title: Bipartisan Starter Homes Act unveiled at Capitol
item.description: Minnesota lawmakers unveil the bipartisan Starter Homes Act, requiring cities to adopt upzoning measures aimed at boosting housing production statewide.

item.title: Anoka psychiatric hospital to add 50-bed facility
item.description: A $75M state-funded project will add a 50-bed inpatient facility at Anoka-Metro Regional Treatment Center, expanding mental health capacity.
